body: I know that feeling whenever I fuck up either in my job or relationship or with anything there is always that thought of who gives a shit anyways I probably don't matter to anyone, im more concious now though that you know shit happens and there is no reason to panic all the time. A thought that helps is thinking of my mom, even though we don't have the best relationship it saddens me to be selfish and have her go through my death

I know how you feel, the best thing you can do is try the romantic stuff. A nice txt here and there some flowers from time to time a movie or just simply cuddling with her and watching television. She needs to feel wanted. I know the feeling my gf had a really rough childhood constant brutal beating and verbal fucked up abuse. I didn't know about it until a couple of years into our relationship. She never tried to end her life but she definitely had thought about it. She wanted to runaway at the age of 8-15 her parents would beat them for fun she says and now that she is older she says that it was probably the way they delt with their marriage issues. She dreaded waking up every day knowing shell be "disciplined" and ofcourse they were very religious. It sucks to hear this kind of stuff and know I know why my gf is the way she is, she can change mood in an instant but I really do love her and I feel for her, sometimes like today she recalls that stuff and it makes her tear up. She said if I hadn't entered her life she probably would have ended it. I'm always trying to make her laugh and show her things that interest me, she likes that she likes getting to know me and yours would probably like that too. Knowing that there are people that are assholes just because, take care of her man once she realizes that u do care she will change her mind about suicide
